name: Inma no Seiiki ~Wasurerareta Mitsurin no Jiin Iseki ni Kodaibunmei no Chou Injuu o Mita!!~
original_name: 淫魔の聖域 ～忘れられた密林の寺院遺跡に古代文明の超淫獣を見た!!～
source:
Deep in the forgotten forest, verdant growth shrouded 
the decrepit remains of a tribal temple... a dwelling of 
dreadful violators! 
Coiling tentacles constrict heroines in an orgy of hellish ecstasy. 
A grand journey & tentacle assault AVG! 

The archaologist "Prof" (main heroine), 
joined by her plucky, tomboyish assistant Akari 
and her cute friend Fanita, pass through a culture 
portal via these ruins. Inside they discover its lascivious 
secret... The ancient civilization of Sotisthunra 
erected this sexual altar for the sake 
of the sprawling spermexa that lay dormant...! 

These girls may have discovered great history, 
but will they survive it!!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095760.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
在被遗忘的森林深处，翠绿的植被掩映着一座破败的部族寺庙遗迹……可怕侵犯者的巢穴！盘绕的触手将女主角们束缚在地狱般快感的狂欢之中。壮大的冒险与触手侵犯AVG！

考古学家“教授”（女主角），与她活泼的假小子助手朱莉以及可爱的朋友法妮塔一起，通过这些遗迹中的文化传送门进入。在里面她们发现了其中淫靡的秘密……古代文明索提斯图恩拉为了沉睡中的蔓延型精子兽而建造了这座祭坛……！

这些女孩也许发现了伟大的历史，但她们能活着出来吗！！？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095760.html]DLsite English[/url]]
